description: This is a test source file for the SimpleVersionGeneratorPlugin class, containing unit tests that verify its behavior in different scenarios such as environment variable handling, static version fallback, and property overrides.

classes.name: SimpleVersionGeneratorPluginTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of SimpleVersionGeneratorPlugin in various scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and mocks before each test.

methods.name: testFactoryExistsInExtension
methods.description: Verifies that the plugin creates the 'autoVersioning' extension.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashOnNullApply
methods.description: Ensures applying the plugin with null does not cause crashes.

methods.name: testRegisterAfterEval
methods.description: Checks that the plugin registers an afterEvaluate action.

methods.name: testFailsIfEnvironmentVariableWasNotSet
methods.description: Verifies that missing environment variable causes an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testTakesValueFromEnv
methods.description: Checks that version data is correctly derived from environment variables.

methods.name: testTakesValueFromEnvAndOffsetBuildCounter
methods.description: Verifies version calculation with build counter offset.

methods.name: testOnlyUsesStaticIfDisabled
methods.description: Ensures static version is used when plugin is disabled.

methods.name: testTakesStaticIfEnvNotAvailable
methods.description: Checks fallback to static version when environment variable is missing.

methods.name: testTakeForceValueWhenSpecified
methods.description: Verifies that a forced build count overrides environment variable.

methods.name: testUsesOverrideDefaultBuildCount
methods.description: Checks that default build count is used when environment variable is absent.
